cells.rationale: Stands up a new dual-runtime surface and a DST/fold-sensitive Temporal wrapper whose wall-clock math must match Python exactly, so a wrong abstraction propagates into every parser.
A 1:1 parser port with subtle branching precedence, regex-translation drift, and exact error_type/JSON-number parity against the wire contract makes this contract-touching, high-blast-radius work.

Corpus and fake-TUI construction follows existing fixtures with Python-generated expected outputs, but the load-bearing paint gate and wrap-split/spinner structural cases need careful cross-module reasoning best kept on opus.
The early-proof spike carries real uncertainty and its go/no-go verdict names the driver stack, so a wrong call propagates across the epic.
The full 1:1 tmux driver port with the subtlest quiet-window-to-snapshot mapping, shared-server invariants, and reaping is the epic's highest-blast-radius implementation.
Porting the CLI arm/exit mapping where key-presence and the subscription tri-state are exactly what keeper validates is contract-touching work where a silent mistake folds to runner_failure.
The cross-runtime conformance harness is the epic's proof surface, requiring deep-equality parity, skip-discipline correctness, and DST-boundary reasoning across paired subprocesses.
